cards.snippet: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.

cards.card_text: For the sake of His servant David, what does the song ask the LORD not to do to His anointed one?
cards.verse_text: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
cards.snippet: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.

cards.card_text: And for His anointed one, what has the LORD prepared?
cards.verse_text: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
cards.snippet: …a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.

cards.card_text: Now Isaiah 61 opens with a voice that doesn't give its name: "The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me…" Anointed, friend, and that means there's a job to do.
cards.verse_text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor.
cards.snippet: …Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor.

cards.card_text: Then the poet speaks of the LORD's anointed.
cards.verse_text: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits.
cards.snippet: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits.

cards.card_text: Before the LORD's anointed was captured, what had the people said about him?
cards.verse_text: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits.
cards.snippet: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits.

cards.card_text: What does God say he was anointed as?
cards.verse_text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.
cards.snippet: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.

cards.card_text: The rest of what's decreed: to stop their transgression, to make atonement for iniquity, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
cards.verse_text: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people and your holy city to stop their transgression, to put an end to sin, to make atonement for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
cards.snippet: …bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.

cards.card_text: No rich food, no meat or wine, and he doesn't anoint himself with oil until the three weeks are done.
cards.verse_text: I ate no rich food, no meat or wine entered my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until the three weeks were completed.
cards.snippet: …food, no meat or wine entered my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until the three weeks were completed.

cards.card_text: They drink wine by the bowlful and anoint themselves with the finest oils.
cards.verse_text: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils, but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

cards.card_text: The LORD says they'll press olives but not anoint themselves with ___, and tread grapes but not drink the ___.
cards.verse_text: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
cards.snippet: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.

cards.card_text: The believers say that in this very city, Herod, a ruler, and Pontius Pilate, governor of Judea (Luke 3:1), conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against God's holy servant Jesus, whom He anointed.
cards.verse_text: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
cards.snippet: …and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.

cards.card_text: God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power.
cards.verse_text: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.

cards.verse_text: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
